g.text: J & D Beach House · Frontend API Architecture
React UI Layer ➔ State/Auth Context ➔ lib/api.ts Service Facade ➔ Protocol Gateway ➔ Express/Supabase Ingress
LAYER 1 · USER INTERFACE & PRESENTATION LAYER (React 18 + Vite + TS)
onSubmit={handleBookingSubmit} · onStatusChange={handleCheckInOut} · onAssign={handleTaskUpdate} · onSend={handleChatSubmit} · onOrderSubmit={handleOrderCreate} · onExport={handleCSVExport}
LAYER 2 · CLIENT STATE, CONTEXT & HOOK ORCHESTRATION
Supabase Session Listener · Bearer JWT Access Token Storage & Automatic Refresh
Multi-Role RBAC: customer | staff | receptionist | accounting | administrator · Offline Fallback State
LAYER 3 · FRONTEND API CLIENT & SERVICE ABSTRACTION FACADE (client/src/lib/api.ts)
Central Request Wrapper: req(path, { method = 'GET', body, fallback })
⚡ Bearer Token Injection (Authorization: Bearer <JWT>) · 🛡️ JSON Serialization · 🔄 Resilient Offline Mock Failover · ⚠️ Status & Error Interceptor
requestHandler() ➔ bearerTokenHandler(JWT) ➔ responseHandler(204/JSON) ➔ errorHandler(HTTP 4xx/5xx/CORS) ➔ mockFallbackHandler(Offline Failover)
Intelligent Fallback Layer: Guarantees 0-Crash Operation During Network Outage or Backend Cold Start
FALLBACK_ROOMS · FALLBACK_ANALYTICS · FALLBACK_USERS · FALLBACK_PASS · FALLBACK_SERVICES · FALLBACK_ORDERS · FALLBACK_TASKS · FALLBACK_INVENTORY · FALLBACK_REVIEWS
LAYER 4 · CLIENT COMMUNICATION & PROTOCOL GATEWAY ENGINES
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <JWT>, Content-Type: application/json · 204 No-Content Guard
Session Auth Storage · PostgreSQL CDC Realtime Change Channels
LAYER 5 · NETWORK INGRESS, REVERSE PROXY & BACKEND SECURITY BOUNDARY
🛡️ NGWF Layer 7 Firewall · 🧼 Anti-XSS Payload Sanitizer
🔑 JWT Bearer Auth Verification · 👮 RBAC Role Validation
🐘 Supabase PostgreSQL 15+ Core DB (GiST Guard & RLS)
📱 Twilio SMS Dispatcher · 🗄️ Media Cloud Storage
authRouteHandler · roomsRouteHandler · reservationsRouteHandler · tasksRouteHandler · ordersRouteHandler · analyticsRouteHandler · globalErrorHandlerMiddleware
Solid Arrows = Synchronous JSON/REST & State Pipelines · Flow denotes Layer 1 (UI) down to Layer 5 (Backend Gateway)
